text:
maya_cs: Heads-up - Tideway Health is doing a soft launch tomorrow morning and asked for a temporary regional lift + allowlist. They want EU + APAC enabled and a short-term rate bump for 48h.
elaine_se: Need the customer CIDRs and expected qps. also do they need specific region pinning or just global fallback?
maya_cs: They sent IP ranges: 34.213.12.0/22, 103.45.67.128/25, and 2001:db8:ac10::/48. Expected peak ~ 1.2k rps across regions. Pin EU first, APAC as fallback. Ticket #CS-10234.
giri_netops: ok I can add the CIDRs to the edge allowlist and create a peering entry for ap-northeast-1. ETA ~30m once we get approval.
oliver_devops: For the rate window we should do a temporary policy: window=48h, qps=1400, burst=2000, then auto-revoke. I'll paste the patch we can apply to config-store.
oliver_devops: ```
PATCH /v1/customers/tideway/config
{
  "allowlist": ["34.213.12.0/22","103.45.67.128/25","2001:db8:ac10::/48"],
  "regions": ["eu-west-1","ap-northeast-1"],
  "rate_override": {"qps":1400,"burst":2000,"expires_in":"48h","auto_revoke":true}
}
```
ryan_support: Noting renewal flag - customer adoption looks better if launch goes smooth. I'm placing a success PM to monitor error rates and latency; will escalate to SRE if p50 latency > 300ms.
sanjay_pl: +1 on auto-revoke. Also suggest we set a canary on eu-west-1 (10% traffic) for first hour, then open to full. Let's avoid sudden quota spikes affecting other tenants.
maya_cs: @oliver_devops can you run the canary rollout and confirm the allowlist changes? I need confirmation before I tell the customer it's live. :pray:
oliver_devops: will do - applying allowlist now and will kick off canary at 06:00 UTC. I'll post the deploy-bot log once done.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled by oliver_devops - canary rollout to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-26T06:00:00Z. Job id: deploy-7732. :rocket:
oliver_devops: canary started. monitoring metrics, no 5xx spikes so far.
giri_netops: peering config pushed for ap-northeast-1. propagation check ok.
oliver_devops: canary at 10% for 1h completed, promoting to 100% now. rate override active. curl example to inspect:
oliver_devops: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBOW_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/customers/tideway/config
# expect rate_override.qps == 1400
```
maya_cs: Confirmed from customer - requests are flowing and they reported lower tail latency. Customer very happy. adding note to CS-10234 and marking as high-probability renewal improvement. :tada:
ryan_support: I'll keep checks on error budget and open a watch for 24h. If anything odd, page the oncall.
maya_cs: Thanks everyone - will close this thread once auto-revoke hit and we verify no followups. :white_check_mark:
